name: Light Field Tomographic Reconstruction from Focal Stack
aliases: Light Field Tomographic Reconstruction from Focal Stack — Epipolar Image Reconstruction, Masked Back-projection
Partial light field tomographic reconstruction from a focal stack
definition: The method reconstructs a 2D epipolar image (a slice of the 4D light field) from a focal stack (a set of 2D images focused at different depths). It treats the focal stack as 1D projections of the light field and uses back-projection to recover the 2D structure, estimating projection angles from a depth map derived from focus cues.
